extracted.name: Corn and Avocado Salsa
extracted.description: This easy salsa combines corn, avocado, onion, and bell pepper to make a quick, yummy tortilla chip dip or a tasty topping for grilled chicken or steak.
ingredient_lines: 3 ears fresh corn, husks and silks removed
1 red bell pepper, seeded and diced
salt and black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Place the corn in a large pot with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil. Cook until kernels are tender but crisp, about 5 minutes. Drain, and cool in cold water. Use a knife to cut kernels from the cobs.
Place kernels in a medium bowl. Stir in avocados, red onion, bell pepper, vinegar, cilantro, lime juice, olive oil, garlic, cumin, and crushed red pepper flakes. Season with salt and pepper.
